title: Named agent host adapters and controlled subtask parallelism
principles: AWR admission, cancel request, and session end are coordination facts — never real process start or kill.
Adapters declare start, status_read, stop_confirmation, reconnect_resume, and result_forensics independently.
Unsupported adapter capabilities must surface a human_continuation path.
L0 manual/client execution reporting remains first-class alongside named controlled adapters.
Not every host must be auto-startable.
Independent subtasks under a parent keep task identity, own claims, and resource boundaries.
Parent rollup references child outcomes; it does not copy child artifacts.
Parent session exit does not auto-complete or release unknown child executions.
Explicit concurrency caps and user pause are enforced before dispatch.
Reconnect/retry queries the original execution first; never duplicate side effects.

subtask_rules.identity: each scheduled subtask has work_id + claim_id + resource_bounds
subtask_rules.ordering: hard dependencies decide start order; independent tasks may run in parallel
subtask_rules.internal_helpers: read-only helper calls may remain execution detail without separate claims
